header.description: The numbers and devices allowed to get online once this property is closed to everyone else.

switch.title: Only allow the guests on this list
switch.on: On. Only the numbers and devices below get online at {{place}}.
switch.off: Off. Every guest signs in on the WiFi login page and gets online — this is how {{place}} works today.
switch.explainer: Turning this on does not hide your WiFi: everyone still reaches your login page, and the people below keep working. Everyone else is refused on that page, in your words, and is never sent a verification code. The list is checked when someone signs in, so anyone already online stays online until their session ends.
switch.ariaLabel: Only allow the guests on this list at {{place}}

denials.unavailable: Refused guests: not available right now
denials.capped: {{count}}+ guests were refused here in the last 24 hours
denials.count_one: {{count}} guest was refused here in the last 24 hours
denials.count_other: {{count}} guests were refused here in the last 24 hours
denials.explainer: Every refusal is recorded against this property. A number far higher than you expect usually means a list entry is stored in a form that cannot match anyone — check the entries below still show a country code.

message.label: What a refused guest sees
message.placeholder: e.g. Ask the front desk to add your number to the guest WiFi list.
message.help: Shown on your WiFi login page to anyone who is not on the list. Leave it empty and guests see the standard message instead.

confirm.title: Refuse everyone not on this list at {{place}}?
confirm.effect: From the moment you save, a guest who is not on the list still reaches your WiFi login page and is refused there. They are not sent a verification code and no session starts for them.
confirm.scope: This changes {{place}} only. Your other properties keep working exactly as they do now, and you can switch this back off at any time.

form.whoNumber: The guest's mobile number, and who it belongs to.

form.windowHelp: How long this entry stays on the list.

list.subtitle: Everything currently allowed across your account.
list.emptyBody: Add a guest's mobile number or device above. When the switch above is on, only guests on this list can sign in. For a printer or till that should connect without signing in, use Trusted Devices.
